a: If you don't suspend this card, the part after "then" in its [Your Turn] effect won't let you perform an app fuse.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon get linked, by suspending this Tamer, those Digimon get +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends. Then, 1 of your Digimon may app fuse into a Digimon card in the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
